description: Load this skill for every project containing interactive UI elements — buttons, links, modals, dropdowns, sliders, tabs, carousels, or any custom widget. Under no circumstances create an interactive component that cannot be fully operated by keyboard alone. Absolutely always ensure visible focus indicators, logical tab order, and no keyboard traps. Apply these rules to every interactive element without exception.
